sources.title: What is the Astute Graphics subscription?

keyLimits.en: Approx. USD 149/year (about USD 12.42/month equivalent) for the full collection of Adobe Illustrator plugins, 12 months of updates, tutorials and support; exact figure not shown on the pricing page itself but confirmed via search of official/docs sources; price rose in February 2026 for new and existing customers.
Per-seat annual pricing with volume discounts for teams of 5 and 11+ members; exact amount not public, requires quote.

cautions.en: The pricing page did not display the exact individual-plan dollar amount directly in this session; the commonly cited USD 149/year figure comes from official/docs sources found via search and should be re-verified on a future pass.
Subscription lapses end plugin access entirely per the official subscription FAQ; it does not confirm any plugins remaining usable for free after cancellation, contradicting some third-party claims.

capabilities.en: Suite of specialized Adobe Illustrator plugins (around 18-21 tools) covering vector cleanup (Vector First Aid), sketching (DynamicSketch), ink/line work (InkFlow, InkScribe), and color/geometry utilities.
Subscription includes the entire plugin collection plus 12 months of updates and new features.
Extensive tutorial library (video and blog resources) and technical support included with subscription.

limitations.en: No standalone free version; a 7-day trial (no payment details required) is the only no-cost access to the full suite.
Plugins only extend Adobe Illustrator and require an active, compatible Illustrator installation (2021-2026); they are not a standalone application.

reason.en: Astute Graphics plugins extend Illustrator directly; some users compare the cost of the add-on suite against staying with Illustrator's native tools alone.
Alternative vector/raster design suite sometimes chosen instead of an Illustrator-plus-plugins workflow.
Vector design tool increasingly used for illustration and iconography work that would otherwise rely on Illustrator plus Astute Graphics.

missingAlternatives.name: Vectornator / Linearity Curve
missingAlternatives.reason: Standalone vector illustration app with built-in precision tools comparable to some Astute Graphics plugins, not in the catalogue.

unknowns: Exact individual-plan annual price (USD 149/year per third-party/docs mentions) was not directly visible on the fetched pricing page in this session; needs re-verification.
Enterprise per-seat price and exact discount tiers for 5+ and 11+ seats are not public.
